study_identification_part.si4_title: Transdiagnostic dimensions of psychopathology explain individuals' unique deviations from normative neurodevelopment in brain structure

study_characteristics_part.sc1_study_objective: Evaluate whether deviations from normative neurodevelopmental models of cortical volume improve out-of-sample prediction of transdiagnostic psychopathology dimensions compared to raw cortical volume, and test regional associations and case-control effects (depression, ADHD).

clinical_application_and_analysis_part.caa8_key_findings_brief: Deviations improved out-of-sample prediction for overall psychopathology, positive psychosis, and fear versus raw volume. Regional deviations in vmPFC, inferior temporal, and daCC correlated more with overall psychopathology than specific dimensions. Case–control deviation effects overlapped and were reduced after controlling for overall psychopathology.
